summary: Join our Women's Political Participation Training Course to enhance your leadership abilities and engage effectively in the political landscape.
lede: Women’s political participation training helps women leaders, activists and allies prepare to influence governance and decision-making. Participants explore gender and power dynamics, develop campaign strategies, and practise communication and negotiation for advocacy, voter engagement and building alliances. They can also shape a personal political action plan around their goals, supporters and next steps.
audienceIntro: This training is ideal for women leaders, activists, and professionals who seek to influence decision-making or participate in governance processes, including:
audience: Aspiring women politicians and public leaders
Members of political parties and civic movements
NGO leaders and program managers in democracy
Community mobilizers, youth leaders, and activists
Policy analysts, educators, and trainers in leadership
